entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Alex. How can I help you today?
I need to return my VeloBand Pulse. Order number is VF789-01B.
Okay, one moment while I pull that up... I see the order for Jane Doe. Is that you?
Yes. Look, I'm busy. Can we just get this done? It's broken.

Of course, Ms. Doe. I see here the band was delivered 17 days ago. And thank you for being a VeloFit VIP member. To get you the fastest solution, can you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
It's a technical fault. The device is not working. I've charged it, I've reinstalled the app, but it just won't sync.
I understand the frustration when a new device won't sync. So just to confirm, you believe the unit is defective?
Yes, it's defective. It's a broken piece of plastic. I just want my money back or a new one sent out today.

I can definitely help with that. Since the issue is a technical one and we're just outside the 10-day return window for the Pulse, our policy is to connect you with our Technical Support team. They are equipped to troubleshoot, confirm the defect, and can immediately authorize a warranty replacement for you.
Transfer me? Why can't you just handle it? This is wasting my time.

I completely understand, and this is the most direct path. Our tech specialists have the tools to verify the hardware issue, which is a required step for a warranty claim. As a VIP member, I can ensure you're placed at the front of their queue. It's the quickest way to get a new unit shipped. May I transfer you?
Front of the queue? Fine. If it's the fastest way, do it.
Excellent. I'll do a warm handoff so you don't have to repeat yourself. Please hold for one moment while I connect you.
